jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
*This is a McGill University student club position

Position Description:
Attending and engaging in bi-weekly PPU Executive meetings 
Submitting budget proposals at the beginning of each semester on behalf of the PPU. 
Tracking the financial activities of the PPU with the budget created for each semester.
Approving, in conjunction with the President(s), all PPU expenditures. 
Submitting and managing cheque requests for all Executive Committee members. 
Ensuring adequate sources of funding for PPU events, workshops, and initiatives. 
Help manage compensation owed to EUS photographers for paid work in conjunction with the President(s).

Requirement
Applicants must be members of the EUS (aka. an undergraduate student in McGill's Engineering Faculty)
